text:
ajay: quick heads-up — noticed some shortlinks in the onboarding KB returning 403 after recent CDN change. Page: /kb/onboarding/welcome. Anyone owns this doc?

katie: i was looking at that yesterday. I can take initial triage. do we know which assets are 403ing? images or shortlinks?

sam: prob shortlinks. ran curl: `curl -I https://assets.redwood.com/short/xyz` -> 403. might be the shortlink rotation script.

maria: @katie if you want me to rehost the screenshots i can push to our internal s3 bucket and update mdx. low risk.

katie: thanks @maria — can you hold until i confirm which files? i'll post a quick list in 10m.

docs-bot: Linkscan: automated scan flagged 4 orphan shortlinks in /kb/onboarding, severity: medium.

lex: fyi, i updated the shortlink mapping yesterday evening. maybe rotation didn't propagate to the cdn edge. pinging infra.

ajay: @lex thanks. @infra-team can you check the shortlink sync job from last night? it's the one that pushes mappings to the cdn.

sam: re infra: could be TTL mismatch + cache purge missing. infra runbook step: `scripts/shortlink-sync --dry-run`

lex: infra acknowledged in #eng-infra. they said they're running a cache walk and will report.

katie: ok i'm going to open a tiny PR to replace the three screenshot shortlinks with direct s3 URLs as a fallback, with a TODO to revert after infra confirms. will add test snapshot.

maria: i'll prep rehost artifacts and add alt text while the PR's open.

ajay: sounds good. add me as reviewer. If infra confirms fix we can revert in a follow-up. :+1:

docs-bot: Update: infra reported cache propagation delay resolved at 1745553000. please verify pages.

katie: checked staging - images load now. leaving the PR as draft until we decide rehost vs trust cdn. standup note: will pair with infra tomorrow.

ajay: closing the loop: if staging stays green by EOD, we'll close this without rehost. thanks team.
